description: Read-only RAL enumeration of a node's current package/user/group/service (default) and mount/cron (opt-in) state via `puppet resource <type> --to_yaml` (query form only, never a set-form invocation). User password hashes and cron command-line secrets are redacted before the result leaves the node. A single slow/failed type times out or errors independently of the others.

types.description: Resource types to enumerate. Each is queried as `puppet resource <type> --to_yaml` — never a set form with a title or attr=value.
types.type: Array[Enum[package, user, group, service, mount, cron]]
